'''Dean''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] technician of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3641 BBY]] he was on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], where during the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] he and another Republic technician were captured by an escaped criminal [[Skadge]] and forced at gunpoint to retrieve information from the databanks of a destroyed [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[M3-OB]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dean appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during a Bounty Hunter class mission on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].
